claim: SRU consequences for the petroleum system: (1) reservoir - the Late Miocene sediment-routing switch set up by SRU uplift charged the IVD-IVE fairways incl. the Rotan pay (NN10); (2) trap - SRU deformation timing vs diapir growth controls whether Rotan-type closure against the diapir pre-dates charge; (3) seal - inboard SRU erosion can breach seals, offshore (conformable SRU) cannot; (4) correlation - equating the inboard angular SRU with a deepwater zone boundary is the Rotan 'IVC vs IVD' error, the mechanism by which an age model goes wrong. Reading rules: angular discordance = tilt; hiatus-triangle width (Krebs) = depth of erosion = contour of uplift; erosion->conformity transition = hinge separating source from sink.
